attchmntText: Jindal Poly Investment and Finance Company Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
sm_name: Jindal Poly Investment and Finance Company Limited
voiceSummary: Jindal Poly Investment and Finance Company Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board appointed Mr. Devendra Singh Rawat as Additional Director and Mr. Rathi Binod Pal as Additional Non-Executive Non-Independent Director, both subject to shareholder approval. Mr. Suresh Kumar Shukla was appointed Chief Financial Officer effective November 13, 2026, succeeding Mr. Sunil Kumar Gupta. Standalone profit for the half year was 3,155 lakh rupees with basic earnings per share of 30.01. Consolidated profit for the half year was 3,488 lakh rupees with basic earnings per share of 815.75. The Audit Committee and other committees were reconstituted effective November 12, 2026.
